data.title: Paragon
data.about:
Impeccably positioned near Downtown and Dubai’s high profitable area, The Paragon by IGO combines sophisticated megacity style with all of the benefits of trendy community living. 

An upmarket life with further amenities than you could imagine, these apartments are created for the future-inclined buyer who won’t settle for anything but unmatched perfection. Enwrapping a high corner position in the vibrant heart of Business Bay, The Paragon offers 21 floor ranging from well-designed studios, 1, 2, 3 – bedroom apartments. Each home is ultra-modern with impeccable aesthetics and boasts continued water views of the Dubai Canal or lush lookouts of the beneath.

location_tile.title: Business Bay is a professional area, and houses some of the most high-rise offices and contemporary co-working spaces.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: It is located close to Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai Healthcare City and the Dubai World Trade Centre. Business Bay offers more than just work and city living. It has a fantastic social scene. World-famous dining destinations, such as The Maine Brasserie, Zuma, Armani Ristorante, Nusr-Et Steakhouse and Gaia, are just minutes away. Alongwith these fantastic gourmet destinations, you also have lovely cafes, bars, fitness centres and luxurious spas.
